name: floormat
description: FloorMat - SVG floor plan layout generation tool (MaxInscribed, Boardroom, Hollow Square)

scripts.test:samples: node run-tests.js test-configs/maxinscribed-sample.json && node run-tests.js test-configs/boardroom-sample.json && node run-tests.js test-configs/hollowsquare-sample.json
scripts.test:all: npm run test:maxinscribed && npm run test:boardroom && npm run test:hollowsquare
scripts.pipeline: npm run test:all && npm run extract && npm run embed
scripts.pipeline:quick: npm run test:samples && npm run extract && npm run embed
